seeded_failure.symptom: In Jira, attempting to move a completed feature ticket into 'Ready for Release' displays a transition rejection error.
seeded_failure.cause: The transition condition requires an attached security scan report artifact and an approved Git pull request link, which are missing from the ticket.
seeded_failure.fix: Link the approved pull request URL and attach the security scan artifact to the Jira ticket, then trigger the workflow transition again.

seeded_failure.symptom: The target system service enters a failed state immediately upon startup.
seeded_failure.cause: The service log file /var/log/app.log is owned by root with 0600 permissions, preventing the application user from writing to it.
seeded_failure.fix: Run chown appuser:appuser /var/log/app.log and restart the service using systemctl restart app.
